Physics and Astronomy

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Physics and Astronomy at Radboud studies the physical laws of matter and the universe through theory, mathematics, computation and experiments. The Dutch-taught bachelor develops mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum physics and astronomy, concluding with an individual research internship.

UCR offers useful connections through mathematics, programming, data science, Earth systems and neuroscience. These courses do not support a complete programme centred on the physical theories and experimental methods that define Physics and Astronomy. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary Dutch-taught single bachelor

The 180 EC programme comprises 60 EC in the first year, 69 EC of later required courses, 39 EC of eligible elective/minor space and a 12 EC individual research internship. The optional astronomy minor, dual degree and older-cohort substitutions are separate. First-year PPD and the later portfolio each carry 3 EC. The required Dutch academic-language diagnostic adds no credits; participation, rather than passing, is required.
